hooks.logic:
Run helper3.
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
If condition flag "on_damage" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'onDamagedCnt' by one.
If condition flag "evil_retaliatory_strike_done" is up this frame, then set the register's 'onDamagedCnt' to 0.
Let v be the register's 'bpConfsIdxMap' at 1.
Let v2 be run helper on 1.
If v is not v2, then
  Helper2 → call with (this state, 1, v2).
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let v3 be unset.
  Let number be the numeric entry "count_of_on_damaged_for_evil_retaliatory_strike" in the battle settings of the acting enemy.
  Let onDamagedCnt be the register's 'onDamagedCnt'.
  Set v3 to if number is at most onDamagedCnt then the id of the move labelled "evil_retaliatory_strike" on part else a smart-weighted move of part.
  Part uses v3.

Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.

condition flag "evil_retaliatory_strike_done" is up this frame
Let v be the register's 'bpConfsIdxMap' at 1.
Let v2 be run helper on 1.
v is not v2
part is ready to act

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
Let part be part arg1 of the acting enemy.
Set the script register's 'bpConfsIdxMap' at arg1 to arg2.
Let paramSuffixNo be data at arg1 at arg2's 'paramSuffixNo'.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form paramSuffixNo on part.
Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
